content.comment_body: I'm trying to understand how to enable message acknowledgment on an HMI device.
Hello, simply activate this option in the properties of the message text field. Hope this resolves your question.

Hi, within the function block for message text, there's a help button. By clicking it, you can get details about the feature. For example: If the 'Acknowledgement message' checkbox isn't selected, the message text disappears when input En changes from 1 to 0. When the checkbox is selected, after input En turns to 0, the message text stays visible until you press the OK button (on certain devices). It can't be acknowledged while input En is high.
